video_title: "The Man and His Tiny Horse" - Radahn The Starscourge - #eldenring #fromsoftware
comments: Well he did learn gravity magic just to ride his horse, he’s my absolute favourite boss in every way possible. Both of the boss fights, the design, the lore, everything about this character is amazing

Even when his literal brain is rotting away and he lost all humanity and sanity and became a beast, He still holds back the stars and adjusts himself for his horse. Radahn is my favorite souls boss ever and one of my top 3 favorite game bosses ever

He loved his horsey and his horsey love him
His horse used to be a mighty steed able to hold his weight when he was young but now since radahn has grown exponentially his horse is tired and battered from carrying his weight

The way this boss really makes you understand the ONLY reason you are somehow defeating these demigods and surviving this world is because everything is inches away from death already.

And they still put up that much of a fight.

This man, with literal brainrot, is capable of literally holding the stars in place, delicately protecting his horse, AND ATTACKING YOU WITH EVEN MORE GRAVITY MAGIC.

A warhorse is more than a horse or friend, it’s someone you trust completely. He mastered gravity to hold back the stars while constantly adjusting himself to protect his trusted steed underneath him.
